description.en: 基于 Chakra UI 的预制组件集合，组件都配了在线代码编辑器，抄之前可以先把代码改一改。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Choc UI (https://www.choc-ui.com/).
Technology stack: react.
Component specification: 在 Live Editor 里改完组件代码再整块抽进项目


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
